create_dictionary: create a Dictionary instance with custom bos, pad, eos, and unk special symbols
load_dictionary_from_file: load a pre-existing Dictionary from a text file using the load class method
encode_line_to_ids: encode a text line into token indices using encode_line with optional eos appending
convert_tensor_to_string: convert a tensor of token indices back to a human-readable string using the string method
finalize_dictionary: finalize a Dictionary by filtering symbols by frequency threshold and padding to a multiple of 8
